D/ CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 332-333, RIC vol. 7 page 216 no. 538, Reece period 17, in very fine condition. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG.
